name: superpowers-multi-subagents
description: Extension for superpowers (required, install it first): runs plan tasks on external agents such as OpenCode, Codex, Claude Code, Cursor and aider, with host subagents as fallback

interface.shortDescription: Run superpowers plan tasks on external agents
interface.longDescription: An extension for superpowers, which must be installed first. It adds a tier and effort to each plan task and sends every dispatch through a router that picks an installed agent (OpenCode, Codex, Claude Code, Cursor, aider) and falls back to host subagents.
